entries.title: Luke 19:1
segments: So he entered Jericho and was passing through the town.

entries.title: Luke 19:2
segments: There was a man there, called Zaccheus, who was a chief of the tax-gatherers, and was wealthy.

entries.title: Luke 19:3
segments: And he kept trying to see what sort of a man Jesus was; but he could not see because he was short.

entries.title: Luke 19:4
segments: So he ran on before him and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him; for he was about to pass that way.

entries.title: Luke 19:5
segments: As soon as Jesus came to the place, he looked up and said to him, "Come down quickly, Zaccheus, for today I must stay at your house."

entries.title: Luke 19:6
segments: He made haste to climb down, and receive him joyfully.

entries.title: Luke 19:7
segments: When they all saw it, they began to complain, saying "He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner."

entries.title: Luke 19:8
segments: But Zaccheus stood up and said to the Lord, "I give half my property to the poor, Lord, and if I have defrauded any man of anything I am restoring it to him fourfold."

entries.title: Luke 19:9
segments: "Today is salvation come to this house," said Jesus "since Zaccheus here is a son of Abraham.

entries.title: Luke 19:10
segments: "For the Son of man is come to seek and to save the lost."

entries.title: Luke 19:11
segments: As they were listening to his words he added this parable, because he was near Jerusalem and they thought that the kingdom of God was immediately to appear.

entries.title: Luke 19:12
segments: So he said: "A certain nobleman went abroad to receive for himself royal power and to return.

entries.title: Luke 19:13
segments: "And he summoned ten slaves of his, and gave them ten pounds, and said to them, "`Trade with these until I come.'

entries.title: Luke 19:14
segments: "But this fellow citizens hated him, and sent a deputation after him to say, `We do not wish this man to become our king.'

entries.title: Luke 19:15
segments: "And upon his return after he had secured the royal power, he ordered the slaves to whom he had given the money to be called in, so that he might know what they had gained by trading.

entries.title: Luke 19:16
segments: "And the first came before him, saying, `Master, your pound has made ten pounds.'

entries.title: Luke 19:17
segments: "And he said to him, `Well done, good slave! Because you have been faithful in a very little, have authority over ten cities.'

entries.title: Luke 19:18
segments: "And the second came and said, `Master, your pound has made five pounds.'

entries.title: Luke 19:19
segments: "Then he said to him also, `You shall be over five cities.'

entries.title: Luke 19:20
segments: "And the next came to him and said, `Here master is your pound which I was keeping safe in a napkin.

entries.title: Luke 19:21
segments: "`For I was afraid of you, because you are a hard man. You take what you did not sow.'

entries.title: Luke 19:22
segments: "He said to him, "`By your own words I will Judge you, you wicked slave. You knew, did you, that I was a hard man taking up what I did not lay down, reaping what I did not sow.

entries.title: Luke 19:23
segments: "`Then why did you not put my money into the bank, so that at my coming I might I might have gotten it back with interest?'

entries.title: Luke 19:24
segments: "Then to those who stood by, he said, `Take the pounds from him and give it to him who has ten pounds.'

entries.title: Luke 19:25
segments: "`Master,' they said to him, `he already has ten pounds.'

entries.title: Luke 19:26
segments: "`I tell you that to every one who has it shall be given; and from him who has not shall be taken away even what he has.

entries.title: Luke 19:27
segments: "`Howbeit these enemies of mine who were not willing for me to become their King, bring them here, and slay them in my presence.'"

entries.title: Luke 19:28
segments: When he had so spoken he went on before, going up to Jerusalem.

entries.title: Luke 19:29
segments: When he was come near Bethphage and Bethany at the mount called The Olive Orchard,

entries.title: Luke 19:30
segments: he sent two of his disciples saying: "Go into the village in the front, and on entering it you will find an ass's colt tied, on which no one has ever ridden.

entries.title: Luke 19:31
segments: "Untie it and bring it here. And if any one asks you, `Why are you untying the colt?' Simply say, `The Master needs it.'"

entries.title: Luke 19:32
segments: Then those who were sent out and found it as he had told them.

entries.title: Luke 19:33
segments: For as they were untying the colt, the owners said to them, "Why are you untying the colt?"

entries.title: Luke 19:34
segments: They answered, "The Master needs it."

entries.title: Luke 19:35
segments: So they led it to Jesus, and, after throwing their outer garments on the colt, they placed Jesus on it.

entries.title: Luke 19:36
segments: So he rode on, while they kept throwing their garments in the way.

entries.title: Luke 19:37
segments: And when now he was coming near Jerusalem, and descending the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice, and to praise God with a loud voice for the almighty works they had seen.

entries.title: Luke 19:38
segments: They cried, "Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in Heaven and glory in the Highest"

entries.title: Luke 19:39
segments: And some of the Pharisees said to them out of the crowd, "Teacher reprove your disciples!"

entries.title: Luke 19:40
segments: "I tell you," he answered, "that if these should hold their peace, the very stones would cry out."

entries.title: Luke 19:41
segments: And when he came into view of the city, as he approached it he broke into loud weeping,

entries.title: Luke 19:42
segments: exclaiming: "Oh that at this time you knew, yes, even you, on what your peace depends! But now it is hidden from your eyes.

entries.title: Luke 19:43
segments: "The time will come for you when your enemies will throw ramparts around you, and encompass you, and shut you in on every side, and raze you to the ground,

entries.title: Luke 19:44
segments: "you and your children within you. And they will not leave in you one stone upon the another. Because you knew not the time of your visitation."

entries.title: Luke 19:45
segments: Then Jesus went into the Temple and began to drive out dealers,

entries.title: Luke 19:46
segments: saying, "It is written, "The house of God shall be called a house of prayer, but you have made it a den of robbers."

entries.title: Luke 19:47
segments: Day after day he continued to teach in the Temple. The high priests and scribes tried to have him put to death, so did the rulers of the people.

entries.title: Luke 19:48
segments: But they could not find how to do it, for the people all hung upon him, listening to him.
